content.text:
The up vector now survives a save and reload with `ObjectLoader`. This applies to every `Object3D`, not just cameras. I haven't run any tests or the reproduction from the issue.

- **Saving** (`src/core/Object3D.js`): `toJSON()` now writes `up` as an array, next to `matrix`.
- **Loading** (`src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js`): `parseObject()` reads `data.up` back in when it's there. JSON saved before this change has no `up`, so those objects keep the default `(0,1,0)`.

Every saved object now includes an `up` field, so any test that compares the full `toJSON()` output exactly will need it added to the expected result.
